- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In Women's Artistic Gymnastics (WAG), the individual gold medalists were: Shallon Olsen (Vault, Canada), Kyla Ross (Uneven bars, USA), Madison Desch (Balance beam, USA), Simone Biles (Floor exercise, USA), and Simone Biles (All-around, USA).
